planets.name: Kepler-90 h
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-90 with a 332-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-90 h was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Shaw et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SHAW_ET_AL__2025): disc_year 2013, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 8; pl_orbper 331.5972732, pl_radj 1.00383793, pl_bmassj 0.63870943

quotes.title: Kepler-90h
quotes.card: Kepler-90h is an exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of the early G-type main sequence star Kepler-90, the outermost of eight such planets discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft.
quotes.introduction: It is located about 2,840 light-years, from Earth in the constellation Draco.
